user.title: Connect to a ControlByWeb 400 Series device
user.description: Works with 400 series modules (X-401, X-404, X-408, X-410, X-420 ...) and older WebRelay units (X-WR-1R12). The protocol is detected automatically. Use the Administrator login, or the User login if you enabled a Control Page password; leave the password blank if none is set.

data.model: Model (only used to label the device)

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device or read /state.json

data.onewire_unit: Fallback unit for 1-Wire sensors (only used if the device doesn't report one)
